clips.title: The story
paras: Pixel is an enterprising goblin courier operating out of Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. Making her living delivering heavy goods across dangerous territories, she handles shipments like Warsong saw blades for the local Horde forces—though she never lets any cargo go without proper compensation.

While Splintertree Post serves as a fortified bastion for the Horde amidst the hostile canopies of Ashenvale, Pixel remains firmly focused on profit. As an independent courier willing to haul freight into active war zones, she provides essential logistics for the Warsong Clan's logging efforts. However, true to goblin custom, contracts and coin dictate her cooperation. She holds fast to her deliveries until the client produces payment; for the saw blades, she wants a deadly blunderbuss to protect herself on the road. Always alert to an opportunity, she also pays passing adventurers for satyr horns, which are in high demand in Ratchet.
